siemens.summary: Working student in Siemens Mobility’s Metro Architecture group for Control, Communication, and Information. Supported R&D and customer projects by developing automated tests, software prototypes, scripts, SysML diagrams, and internal engineering tools for metro train systems. Worked on distributed onboard-to-landside architectures using technologies such as MQTT, OPC UA, containerized deployments, Python/Flask, and Vue. Led the development of a developer tool for mocking RPC services, improving testing efficiency for system functions and maintenance applications.

tu_wien.summary: Supervised Bachelor’s and Master’s student teams at TU Wien in semester-long Software Engineering Projects. Conducted weekly mentoring sessions, participated in management reviews, evaluated submissions, and provided technical and organizational feedback throughout the project lifecycle.

lidarc.title: LiDARC
lidarc.description:
This system provides an interactive platform for uploading, processing, and comparing
 pointcloud sets with a focus on efficient analysis and clear visual feedback. Users can 
 submit data through a web-based interface, trigger a comparison, and explore the resulting 
analyses through interactive visualizations. The system is designed to handle
computationally intensive tasks in the background, allowing users to continue working
without interruption while results are generated asynchronously. Created Results can be
viewed and additionally downloaded as a Report.

ontobinocular.title: Ontobinocular
ontobinocular.description: A Knowledge Graph that utilizes RDF, OWL, and a custom software project Ontology that extends on popular SemanGit and SEON ontologies. Makes the data mined by Binocular queryable and can make inherit knowledge explicit by semantic reasoning capabilities.

willgraph.title: Willgraph
willgraph.description: A graph-based real estate search platform for Austria that combines property listings with public transportation and points of interest (POI) data. Built with Neo4j graph database, Spring Boot backend, and Quasar/Vue.js frontend. Real Estate Listings - Scraped from Austrian property platforms (Willhaben, Immoscout) Public Transport Integration - GTFS data from Austrian transport networks POI Search - Find nearby amenities (shops, schools, healthcare, etc.) Interactive Map - Leaflet-based visualization with heatmaps Smart Search - Filter properties by price, size, transport accessibility, and nearby amenities
